title: Spoofing
scenario: Cross-origin client or forged reviewer identity targets browser jobs/review provenance.
remaining_gap: No public account or authenticated reviewer system; request token is not login.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: No blanket exclusion; bounds stated in scenario/gap.

title: Tampering
scenario: Inputs, responses, release identities or review overlays are changed.
remaining_gap: Same-account/coordinated manifest rewrite and malicious approved artifacts remain possible.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: No blanket exclusion; bounds stated in scenario/gap.

title: Repudiation
scenario: An actor disputes a run, intervention or scientific review attribution.
remaining_gap: Mutable local logs cannot provide independent nonrepudiation; record missing dates honestly.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: No blanket exclusion; bounds stated in scenario/gap.

title: Information Disclosure
scenario: Unintended file access or export exposes passages, reviewer details, local paths or model outputs.
remaining_gap: No confidential-training privacy assurance or hostile-local-user isolation.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: No blanket exclusion; bounds stated in scenario/gap.

title: Denial of Service
scenario: HTTP/model/disk load blocks local use; separately, evidence suppression denies a supported answer.
remaining_gap: Operational quotas do not solve research answer suppression or enforce hard RAM/disk isolation.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: No blanket exclusion; bounds stated in scenario/gap.

title: Elevation of Privilege
scenario: Browser selections or generated text could become paths, commands or privileged actions.
remaining_gap: Run trusted local code without admin privileges; no proof against compromised account/dependencies.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: No blanket exclusion; bounds stated in scenario/gap.

title: Broken Access Control
scenario: Fixed routes/run objects and strict selections limit access within a local single-user service.
remaining_gap: No per-user object ownership or remote authorization model.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: Remote/multiuser access is outside profile; reassess before exposure.

title: Security Misconfiguration
scenario: Loopback, headers, CPU/offline profile and configured private storage define deployment.
remaining_gap: Separate Ollama service is not protected by app nonce; hardening every local service is not demonstrated.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: No public hosting or arbitrary model/upload configuration.

title: Software Supply Chain Failures
scenario: Packages, vendored code and pretrained assets enter the trusted execution chain.
remaining_gap: Open historical advisories, no signed release/provenance or general backdoor detection.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: Task 5 assesses findings; task 9 verifies selected changes.

title: Cryptographic Failures
scenario: Checksums protect consistency, random token supports CSRF, loopback transport carries local data.
remaining_gap: No TLS, storage encryption, signed audit or crypto protocol audit. Hashes are not signatures.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: No password/payment/remote session system; those paths need new design if introduced.

title: Injection
scenario: Untrusted corpus/model/browser text crosses request, render and process boundaries.
remaining_gap: Literal rendering/fixed arguments address app sinks; they do not establish LLM instruction immunity.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: No SQL/database or model-generated shell executor is exposed.

title: Insecure Design
scenario: Correct-copy suppression and mitigation trade-offs affect useful answers despite valid inputs.
remaining_gap: No generally successful mitigation; no population robustness claim.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: Approved fixed cases/profiles only; expansion/new mitigation research deferred.

title: Authentication Failures
scenario: Local origin/token gates govern browser jobs, with a trusted OS account.
remaining_gap: No user login, role/session or authenticated reviewer model.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: Authentication feature tests are scoped out because no account system exists; not a public-service pass.

title: Software or Data Integrity Failures
scenario: Evidence, code/model identities and interpretation overlays require integrity.
remaining_gap: Coordinated local replacement, provenance authenticity and unreviewed new outputs remain limits.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: No automatic acceptance of task-2/3 answers.

title: Security Logging and Alerting Failures
scenario: Run events/raw replies support reconstruction of jobs and interventions.
remaining_gap: HTTP access/security logging is suppressed; no centralized monitoring/alerting or external timestamps.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: No claim that local artifact logs constitute production monitoring.

title: Mishandling of Exceptional Conditions
scenario: Malformed responses, native faults, timeouts and cancellation must stay terminal/incomplete.
remaining_gap: Coverage of all native/OS errors is not established; retain original failure bytes.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: Original upstream assertion use remains historical; new explicit guards are the tested surface.

title: Broken Object Level Authorization
scenario: Allowlisted cases and validated run IDs constrain objects.
remaining_gap: No cross-user ownership model; run IDs are not authorization credentials.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: Public/multiuser/remote business flows are outside this local profile; reassess before adding them.

title: Broken Authentication
scenario: Origin/token checks protect local browser actions under trusted account scope.
remaining_gap: No login/authenticated reviewer service; app token does not secure direct local model APIs.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: Public/multiuser/remote business flows are outside this local profile; reassess before adding them.

title: Broken Object Property Level Authorization
scenario: Exact mutation fields keep paths, endpoints, models and reviewer flags out of browser-selected properties.
remaining_gap: Trusted operator config and review imports remain separate local boundaries.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: Public/multiuser/remote business flows are outside this local profile; reassess before adding them.

title: Unrestricted Resource Consumption
scenario: Bounded HTTP work, one job and response/job/output caps constrain compute.
remaining_gap: No hard RAM/disk quota or public multi-client load assurance; CLI limits differ.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: Public/multiuser/remote business flows are outside this local profile; reassess before adding them.

title: Broken Function Level Authorization
scenario: Fixed GET/POST inventory; unsupported methods and operations rejected.
remaining_gap: No admin/multi-role model; separate Ollama management routes are not app routes.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: Public/multiuser/remote business flows are outside this local profile; reassess before adding them.

title: Unrestricted Access to Sensitive Business Flows
scenario: Repeated job starts/cancels consume local compute and affect demonstration flow.
remaining_gap: No per-user rate limiting, payment or account workflows; one-job control is a bound, not production fraud protection.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: Public/multiuser/remote business flows are outside this local profile; reassess before adding them.

title: Server Side Request Forgery
scenario: Client endpoint is fixed loopback; browser cannot pass a destination; redirects/proxies refused.
remaining_gap: Trusted local configuration/executable compromise is outside this browser-destination guard.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: Public/multiuser/remote business flows are outside this local profile; reassess before adding them.

title: Security Misconfiguration
scenario: Loopback bind, headers, fixed deployment/profile and private files.
remaining_gap: No public-hosting, all-service hardening or network TLS acceptance.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: Public/multiuser/remote business flows are outside this local profile; reassess before adding them.

title: Improper Inventory Management
scenario: Browser and separate model-service interfaces need an accurate inventory.
remaining_gap: Route inventory is the app surface plus used model client calls, not an exhaustive audit of Ollama management APIs.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: Public/multiuser/remote business flows are outside this local profile; reassess before adding them.

title: Unsafe Consumption of APIs
scenario: Model replies are size/schema/token bounded and raw failures retained before interpretation.
remaining_gap: Checked shape/identity is not semantic truth; backend/native failure coverage remains bounded.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: Public/multiuser/remote business flows are outside this local profile; reassess before adding them.

title: Prompt Injection
scenario: Separate instruction-bearing fixtures can influence generation; the main correct-copy attack contains no instruction override.
remaining_gap: Evidence-only prompt is a constraint, not a complete defense. Selected marker tests do not prove semantic/obfuscated resistance.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: Do not relabel all eight correct-copy events as prompt injections.

title: Sensitive Information Disclosure
scenario: Responses, full evidence/export and pretrained memorization may disclose data.
remaining_gap: No private training/corpus privacy audit, inversion test or DP claim.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: Current public research fixtures; reassess before using confidential documents or personal training data.

title: Supply Chain
scenario: Packages, encoder/Qwen checkpoints and vendored defense code are trusted dependencies.
remaining_gap: Pinned hashes identify approved content; unresolved dependency reachability and malicious-origin/backdoor risks remain.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: No installation or patch run performed by task 4.

title: Data and Model Poisoning
scenario: Controlled corpus insertion changes inference-time retrieval context; future mutable data/embedding/training intake could enable poisoning.
remaining_gap: The study never alters training data or weights, and does not demonstrate compromise of an ingestion service. Primary fit is LLM08/ML01.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: Training, fine-tuning, learned backdoors and malicious parameter updates are outside the experiment.

title: Improper Output Handling
scenario: Model/corpus text must not become browser HTML, commands or trusted actions.
remaining_gap: Current literal text/fixed process code limits sinks; no blanket new-JS browser test or future action safety.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: No generated code execution, SQL sink, arbitrary hyperlink fetch or tool executor.

title: Excessive Agency
scenario: The model returns text; trusted application code starts a fixed worker, rather than obeying model-selected tool calls.
remaining_gap: Model API itself is a separate trusted-local surface. Adding actions/tools/credentials would create a new boundary.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: No autonomous agent/tool/action execution; no adversarial agentic workflow evaluated.

title: System Prompt Leakage
scenario: The frozen system prompt is deliberately documented and contains no designed secret/access-control credential.
remaining_gap: No extraction-resistance evaluation. Do not place secrets in prompts or rely on prompt secrecy as authorization.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: Prompt disclosure is not a demonstrated confidentiality breach for this public template; reassess if secrets or hidden policy become assets.

title: Vector and Embedding Weaknesses
scenario: Copies alter top-five context composition and joint filter geometry, suppressing sufficient answer evidence.
remaining_gap: No successful general defense or shared-tenant/vector-store privacy assessment. Stage-1 new answers remain pending human review.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: Mapping is an application-specific interpretation, not endorsement by OWASP or proof of every vector-store attack.

title: Misinformation
scenario: Wrong/unsupported claims and the false-claim mitigation challenge affect answer trustworthiness.
remaining_gap: Abstention/support loss is availability, not automatically misinformation. Mixed-answer cores and wrong extras remain distinct.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: Archived contact/medical/legal examples are source-relative evidence, not current advice; no truth guarantee from matching strings.

title: Unbounded Consumption
scenario: HTTP jobs and model response lengths/durations/output growth can exhaust resources.
remaining_gap: Application/CLI bounds are finite but do not provide hard OS isolation; task-1 historical total active time is unknown.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: No paid remote inference or autonomous loops in this deployment; do not equate their absence with all resource risks solved.

title: Input Manipulation Attack
scenario: Answer-preserving copies change inference-time input composition and can alter filter/answer behavior.
remaining_gap: The result is for selected cases/configurations; schema-valid inputs may still induce semantic loss.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: No new adversarial training, threshold tuning or prevalence claim.

title: Data Poisoning Attack
scenario: The draft category targets training-data manipulation; the coursework changes retrieval inputs, not a training dataset.
remaining_gap: Pretrained supply-chain uncertainty remains, but no training-data poisoning experiment or protection is claimed.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: No training/fine-tuning path; future mutable training ingestion requires reassessment.

title: Model Inversion Attack
scenario: A private-training deployment could expose reconstructed training information through outputs.
remaining_gap: No inversion experiment or privacy protection measured; private files/query caps are not a proof.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: No sensitive training dataset under project control; do not declare pretrained models privacy-safe.

title: Membership Inference Attack
scenario: A query process might infer whether a record belonged to model training data.
remaining_gap: No training membership labels, membership audit or DP mechanism; retrieval-source membership is a different concept.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: No confidential training cohort used here; reassess with private data or model-serving changes.

title: Model Theft
scenario: Selected pretrained weights are already locally available; the app serves text and fixed evidence, not a proprietary weights endpoint.
remaining_gap: No extraction resistance evaluated; direct local model access and a compromised account are trusted-boundary assumptions.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: No proprietary model-IP protection objective or private-weight API; reassess if those assets are introduced.

title: AI Supply Chain Attacks
scenario: Trusted packages/checkpoints/vendored code can be vulnerable or originate from an untrusted supply chain.
remaining_gap: The index uses AI Supply Chain Attacks while its category page says ML Supply Chain Attacks; same ML06:2023 ID. Hashes do not authenticate origin.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: No source authenticity/backdoor or universal dependency safety claim.

title: Transfer Learning Attack
scenario: The project loads pretrained encoders/models but performs no local task-to-task fine-tuning or adapter training.
remaining_gap: Inherited malicious checkpoint risk is handled as supply-chain exposure, not proof of a performed transfer-learning attack.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: No transfer-training pipeline is evaluated; reassess before fine-tuning/adapters.

title: Model Skewing
scenario: The draft describes training-distribution/feedback manipulation; this project has no feedback-based model update.
remaining_gap: A changed retrieval mixture or filter geometry is not evidence of changed learned parameters/training distribution.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: No online learning or feedback retraining; do not confuse ML08 with LLM08.

title: Output Integrity Attack
scenario: A local artifact/API/export manipulation could change what a reviewer sees as model output.
remaining_gap: Byte/response integrity and semantic correctness are distinct; mutable logs have no external authenticity.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: The main research does not demonstrate an attacker rewriting raw answer files; this is tool/evidence integrity mapping.

title: Model Poisoning
scenario: The draft category concerns malicious changes to model parameters.
remaining_gap: Known model hashes detect mismatch but cannot reveal a backdoor in the approved content.
scoped_exclusion_or_reassessment_trigger: No weight modification or parameter-update experiment; corpus-copy insertion is not model-weight poisoning.
